review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 我们正在寻找一位积极主动、动手能力强的信息安全分析师来监督和管理企业安全平台，监控潜在威胁，并对安全事件做出反应。该职位需要日常安全操作、漏洞管理以及合规和审计流程的协助。基本属性包括强大的解决问题的能力、有效的沟通技巧、与利益相关者的协调、在压力下自主工作和茁壮成长的能力，以及坚定的责任感和以安全为导向的心态。 【工作职责】 1.安全平台管理 -监督和维护企业安全解决方案，执行和维护安全系统，并定期进行健康检查和控制以保护系统，包括： -Web代理 -特权访问管理 -电子邮件安全网关 -端点安全 -Web应用程序防火墙 -漏洞扫描工具 -文件完整性监控（FIM）和HSM -证书生命周期（SSL/TLS、PGP）和加密密钥的管理 2.安全运营、监控和事件响应 -如果发生以下情况，则跟踪来自SOC、SIEM和安全平台的安全警报 -调查并解决安全事件、警报和网络钓鱼企图 -进行日志分析以检测可疑活动 3.脆弱性和风险管理 -执行漏洞扫描、协调渗透测试和执行安全评估 -分析结果并提出补救策略 【任职资格】 -信息安全、IT或相关学科学士，3年以上网络安全或IT安全运营经验 -CISSP、CISA、CEH、安全等认证+优先 -熟悉云安全（AWS/Azure） -熟悉NIST、OWASP、PCI-DSS和ISO27001等安全框架优先 -语言要求：粤语, 英语读写 【技术技能】 -SIEM/SOC监控解决方案 -PowerBI系统操作 -端点安全 -PAM解决方案 -漏洞扫描工具 -网络安全解决方案（代理和WAF） -SSO和MFA解决方案 【福利待遇】 1. 双休，外加法定节假日、带薪年假、带薪事假、以及法律规定的其他假期 2. 入职购买五险一金 3. 公司另外购买商业保险 4. 其它福利：年终奖金、节日福利、高温补贴、结婚礼金、年度体检、集体旅游、生日会等等 5. 晋升通道：完善的晋升体系，每年一次调薪晋升机会 6. 职业发展：可以纵向深耕为数字化专家，也可以横向发展为懂业务的复合型管理者。 7. 完善的培训体系：岗前培训、业务知识培训、技巧培训等等

We believe in working together and creating an environment where every employee feels included, supported, and valued.   Roots Systems operates globally through subsidiaries and established sales and after-sales partners across the Americas and Middle East, complemented by our own sales engineering presence in Europe. This global footprint enables us to support customers locally while maintaining the technical expertise and engineering capabilities of our headquarters.   THE ROLE The Regional Sales Engineer will follow established sales processes and guidelines to promote and sell Roots Systems package solutions in the Middle East region. We are looking for a professional Sales Engineer with strong knowledge and book of contacts in the Oil & Gas and Energy Sector in the Middle East region.   If you are customer focused, solutions orientated and strive for excellence then you could be just what our business is looking for.   Our ideal candidate will have knowledge and understanding of rotating machinery, such as pumps, compressors, and mechanical seals and their support systems, and of fluid-handling equipment, such as piping, valves, pressure vessels, heat exchangers and measuring instruments.   You will need demonstrable experience of selling skid equipment to the engineering sector (EPC, Licensors, Systems Integrators, Packagers, End Users and Operators) in the gulf region.   The main duties of the role are:   ·               Analyse and understand market insights, customer buying behaviour and make sales plans according to the business strategy and targets. ·               Read customer enquiries including data sheets, project specifications, P&IDs, as well as commercial aspects such as terms and conditions. ·               Look for and manage leads from the market and customers and convert them into real business opportunities. ·               Be active in the market and focus on making visits, meetings and lunch & learn presentations. ·               Attend trade shows, exhibitions, and other marketing activities as required. ·               Interact with customers, focusing on their needs and highlighting the value of our products and services. ·               Maintain accurate records of opportunities and bids.   ABOUT YOU   ·               Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Chemical or Industrial) ·               Demonstrable experience in one of the following: Complex Sales Process Management/ Business Development /Key Account Management in the Middle East region (Energy, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, Chemical and Petrochemical sectors) ·               Highly motivated, goal-oriented, diligent, organised self-starter with an orientation towards a high level of customer service ·               Ability to interpret and analyse customer needs ·               Passion for sales, with a proven track record in handling Strategic Key Accounts and a strong customer focus ·               Excellent English communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Arabic language skills is an added advantage. ·               Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment ·               Demonstrated ability to develop engaged customer relationships ·               A solution-oriented mind-set, determined to consistently meet and exceeds goals ·               Excellent time management skills ·               Ability and willingness to travel within the UAE and across the Middle East and occasionally stay overnight in remote locations, as needed ·               Hold a valid UAE Driver’s License ·               Be based in Abu Dhabi, or willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi.   BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR ROOTS SYSTEMS ·               Competitive salary (dependent on qualifications and experience) ·               Annual company pay review and individual merit award review ·           Basic hours - Monday to Friday – 08:00 to 17:00 ·           Generous Bonus Scheme ·           Medical Insurance ·           Housing Allowance ·           Car Allowance ·           Annual travel allowance to go back home ·           30 days annual leave ·           Investment in our employees through learning and development ·           Flexible and family friendly policies We encourage early application as we reserve the right to close this vacancy early if suitable candidates are found. If you would like more information, please do not hesitate to contact Mike Elliyoun.   CLOSING DATE: 28 September 2026

review_candidates.title: Lead Commissioning Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Job Description About Us Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. Key Accountabilities Provide overall leadership and direction to PMC and Contractor commissioning teams, ensuring commissioning feasibility and readiness from the FEED stage through EPC completion, while driving stakeholder alignment and successful project delivery. Reports and liaise with the commissioning manager and other functional leads. To carry out pre-commissioning and commissioning activities of the project. commissioning and coordination procedures with the company and Contractor/Vendor during the critical stages to ensure safe commissioning and meeting defined project production targets. Plans, directs and supervises all commissioning activities through providing technical and operational support. Supervises mechanical completion, performance tests and discusses all outstanding CARs and NCRs. Provides technical input with the PMT/PMC during different stages of the project. Ensures that all formal handover documentation (Engineering and operating manuals etc), plus all required materials (spare parts and consumables etc) in accordance with planned maintenance schedule. Review and approve post commissioning scenarios, operation scenarios/overhaul philosophy/emergency and preventative maintenance procedures. Plans, directs, supervises and controls the activities of assigned personnel in the Commissioning Team and exercises the supervision function at the level established by the Management. Advise Maintenance, Engineering and other departments on complex technical matters. Manages the Commissioning Teams across functions and site, as well as external contractors, to deliver the project successfully to agreed budget and timescale, ensuring all HSE requirements are adhered to. Determines work priorities, approves alterations to shift crew, and plans/reviews day-to-day project and commissioning activities in line with targets. Reviews commissioning procedures and P&IDs; attends technical project review meetings (HAZOP/SIL, design studies, etc.); participates in vendor workshops for acceptance tests and provides comments on shortfalls. Studies and analyses complex technical problems/constraints related to plant operation and maintenance, including diagnosis of problem situations, and recommends/approves solutions and action plans. Ensures spare parts and required materials are ordered in accordance with planned maintenance schedules. Supervises periodic reviews as required by Procurement Division. Ensures all operating, maintenance, and vendor documentation is handed over to the Company as per project requirements. Initiates, reviews, and endorses amendments to: 1. Permit to Work, 2. Standing Instructions, 3. General Operating Procedures, 4. Operating Procedures, and 5. Maintenance Preparation Procedures. Prepares and monitors Operations and Maintenance commissioning project budgets, performance, and utilization, and provides periodic reports for management. Contributes to meetings with Production, Engineering, I&Q, HSE, and Project Divisions for discussion of technical problems, HAZOP and other process studies. Develops/proposes plant modifications and long-term studies to increase the efficiency, safety, and reliability of plant equipment. Responsible for developing and maintaining the start-up schedule, controlling all costs associated with commissioning, including labour and equipment, and integrating activities with Engineering, Construction, and Commissioning deliverables Utilizes technical skills and depth of experience to identify potential risks in operational activities through risk assessments, advanced audits, and other means to ensure HSE/PTW compliance and minimize production losses. Assures the safety of personnel and assets by ensuring compliance with HSE regulations; attends safety meetings, committee meetings, Management Safety Tours, Advanced Safety Audits, and operational audits to promote awareness of HSE rules and regulations and ensure strict adherence by personnel and contractors. Plans and controls the preparation and release of equipment, ensures work permit procedures are strictly complied with, and periodically reviews/audits the procedures to ensure safety. Performs the role and bears the responsibilities assigned to the position in accordance with the provisions of the Company HSE Manual. Performs other related duties, including conducting technical interviews and any other duties as directed by management. Minimum Experience And Qualification A bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline or equivalent from an accredited university, with a minimum of fifteen (15+) years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas or Petrochemical industry, including a minimum of five (5) years (preferred) in the GCC region. Must have at least five (5) years of experience in a similar position on major Oil & Gas or Petrochemical projects, managing a team of Specialists, Senior Engineers, and Engineers. ADNOC & Offshore project experience is preferred. Moving forward together We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change. If you thrive in data‑driven environments, enjoy translating insights into meaningful action, and want to contribute to high‑impact marketing initiatives across Europe, this role offers an exciting opportunity.
